Which of the following statements is correct?
Option A: Business ethics is not a real concept as the rules and ethics of everyday life don't apply to the world of business.
Option B: Business Ethics is the study of business situations, activities and decisions where issues of right and wrong are addressed.
Option C: Business ethics cannot be defined as a real concept as it is an oxymoronic term.
Option D: Business ethics is concerned with the study of assessing the activities of a business based on their profitability.
